prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting pain and swelling of the right knee. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the presenting complaints are plausible for this type of impact. Over the course of 22 visits, care progressed through a standard sequence of physical examination, imaging review, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Positive findings on examination, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, support the injury, while several other orthopedic and neurovascular tests returned normal results. The patient's history includes a minor strain in the same knee area many years ago, which had fully resolved without lasting limitation. Visit frequency tapered as symptoms improved and function returned, consistent with the expected recovery course. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified.
